hero.subtitle: High-End Web Design & Development. Built fast, built to convert, backed by the systems that keep it running.

webDesignBuilding.heading: Web Design and Building
webDesignBuilding.body: We design and build the site itself, custom, mobile-first, and live on your own domain. Everything else on this list exists to support what gets built here first.

leadAutomation.heading: Follow Up and Lead Response
leadAutomation.body: A missed call is a missed customer. We set up automatic replies so every call, message, or form submission gets a response within minutes, even outside business hours.

digitalPresence.heading: Digital Presence and Reputation
digitalPresence.body: We set up and manage the Google Business Profile so the business shows up correctly in local search and maps. After each visit, a short automatic message asks the customer for a review. The owner never has to remember to ask.

bookingSystems.heading: Booking and Reservations
bookingSystems.body: We connect whichever booking method actually fits the business, a simple WhatsApp line, a dedicated platform, or something in between, so appointments and tables land in one place instead of three different apps.

brandPrint.heading: Brand and Print
brandPrint.body: For businesses that want a complete look, we design the menu, the signage, and the printed materials alongside the site, so everything a customer sees matches.

coreServices.heading: Websites First. Systems That Keep Them Working.

items.title: Web Design & Build
items.description: Custom, high-end websites designed and built in-house, mobile-first from the first pixel. Fast to launch, built to last, and yours to own outright, not a rented template with your logo on it.

items.title: Enquiry & Lead Handling Systems
items.description: Once the site is live, every inbound enquiry, call, form, message, or walk-in, gets logged, tagged, and routed to the right person automatically. Nothing sits in an inbox waiting to be noticed.

items.title: Workflow & Tool Integration
items.description: We connect the calendars, POS systems, and messaging platforms already in use, and layer in automation and AI only where it removes real manual work, not where it looks impressive.

operationalFlow.heading: How a Signal Becomes a Booked Customer

steps.label: Design & Build
steps.detail: The website goes live first, designed and built end to end, before any of the automation gets layered on top of it.

steps.label: Signal
steps.detail: A call, message, booking request, or form submission comes in.

steps.label: Route
steps.detail: The system identifies the type and sends it to the right channel or person.

steps.label: Action
steps.detail: A reply goes out, a slot gets booked, or a task gets created, within minutes.

steps.label: Record
steps.detail: Every interaction is logged, so nothing depends on memory.

tiers.name: STANDARD
tiers.whatYouGet: A custom-built site, live on your own domain, mobile-first from the first pixel. Hosting, SSL, and the legal pages you're required to have, all included, all handled.
tiers.howItWorks: We build it, you approve it, it goes live within days. After that, monthly upkeep keeps it fast, secure, and current, so it never quietly goes stale the way most small business sites do.
tiers.context: A standalone build like this typically runs €399 to €999 before you've even added ongoing maintenance, which usually adds another €30 to €150 a month on its own.

tiers.name: PLUS
tiers.whatYouGet: Everything in Standard, plus a properly optimized Google Business Profile and an automatic system that asks every customer for a review right after their visit, so your rating climbs without you lifting a finger.
tiers.howItWorks: We set up your booking method of choice, whether that's a WhatsApp line or a dedicated platform, connect your Google presence, and manage both every month alongside the site itself.
tiers.context: Buying a website maintenance plan and a Google Business management service separately typically costs €60 to over €130 a month combined. Here it's one plan, one price, one person to call.

tiers.name: PREMIUM
tiers.whatYouGet: Everything in Plus, plus a complete visual identity, your menu, your signage, your printed materials, all designed to match the site and each other, with priority turnaround on every update after launch.
tiers.howItWorks: Your design work runs in parallel with the build, so the whole identity launches together instead of arriving in pieces over separate invoices.
tiers.context: Commissioned separately, a professional menu design alone typically runs €80 to €250, on top of the website and its maintenance. Bundled here, it's part of one launch, at a price below what the pieces would cost apart.

bridge.heading: A beautiful website that doesn't answer the phone is just digital art.
bridge.body: We build the art, but we engineer the infrastructure. Capture the lead, book the table, secure the review. Automatically.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information PeakLogic Digital ("we", "us") collects through peaklogicdigital.com, why we collect it, and the choices you have. We collect as little as we can get away with.
privacy.collectFormText: When you submit the project inquiry form, we collect the name, email address, and message you provide. This is sent directly to us through Web3Forms, a third-party form-processing service, and used only to respond to your inquiry.
privacy.collectCookieText: If you make a choice in the cookie consent banner, we store that choice in your browser's local storage so we don't ask again. This is not sent to us or to any third party.
privacy.noAnalyticsPre: We do not run analytics, advertising, or tracking scripts on this site today. If that changes, it will only run after you explicitly opt in through the cookie consent banner, and this policy and our
privacy.noAnalyticsPost: will be updated to describe it.
privacy.thirdPartyPre: Contact form submissions are processed by
privacy.thirdPartyPost: , which delivers the submission to us and is bound by its own privacy policy. We don't control, and aren't responsible for, how Web3Forms itself handles data in transit.
privacy.retentionText: We keep inquiry details for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to you and, where a project goes ahead, for the duration of that engagement plus a reasonable period afterward for our own records. You can ask us to delete it sooner at any time.
privacy.rightsIntro: You can ask us at any time to:
rightsList: tell you what data we hold about you,
delete data we no longer need a reason to keep, and
stop using your data for a particular purpose.
privacy.rightsOutro: Send that request through the contact form on the homepage, including enough detail (like the email address you used) for us to find your record.
privacy.securityText: This site is served entirely over HTTPS. We don't operate our own database of visitor data — the only place inquiry details live is in the inbox they're delivered to and, briefly, in Web3Forms' systems while delivering them.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This site doesn't set any tracking or advertising cookies today. Here's exactly what it does store, and the choices you have.
cookies.useText: When you choose "Accept All", "Essential Only", or save preferences in the cookie banner, that choice is saved in your browser's local storage — not a cookie — purely so we don't ask again on your next visit. It never leaves your browser.
cookies.useOnly: That's the only thing this site stores in your browser right now. There is no analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking script running.
cookies.changeText: The "Accept All" and "Preferences" options in the banner exist so that if we add an analytics tool in the future (to understand traffic and improve the site), it will only run for visitors who've opted in — never by default. This page will be updated to name the tool and what it stores before that happens.
cookies.thirdPartyPre: Submitting the contact form sends your details to
cookies.thirdPartyPost: , a third-party form processor, which may set its own cookies as part of handling that request. That's governed by their policy, not this one.
cookies.controlText: You can clear your cookie consent choice at any time by clearing this site's local storage in your browser's settings, or by using a private/incognito window. Most browsers also let you block local storage and cookies entirely on a per-site basis.
cookies.changesText: If what we store changes, we'll update the date at the top of this page and, for anything non-essential, ask again through the banner.
